title: TemperPaw — Platform Overview
description: Single pane of glass for OpenPaw agent orchestration health, runtime behavior, and Temper platform metrics.

definition.content: 📊 **ADR-0037 metric migration in progress.** Panels titled "(legacy ... + trace ...)" overlay the existing per-action metrics (warm palette) with the APM trace-metric replacements (cool palette). Once E2E verification confirms `trace.wasm.invoke` spans are flowing (see `.proofs/037z-dd-observability-e2e-plan.md`), the warm-palette legacy series will be removed and the emission sites in temper-observe will be retired. **Expected**: during normal operation, the two series should agree within ~5% for rate and within trace sampling bounds for latency.

definition.content: Profiles are captured on-demand via `GET /_admin/profile/cpu?seconds=N` and `GET /_admin/profile/wall?seconds=N`. Enable with `TEMPER_PROFILING_ENABLED=true`, auto-upload with `TEMPER_PROFILING_AUTO_UPLOAD=true`. Jump to APM → Profiles for flame graphs.
